caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armoire with two tall doors. The armoire is rectangular with a projecting cornice at the top and stands on four curved legs. Each door has two panels with the upper panels featuring a decorative curved outline, while the lower panels are rectangular. The wood is rendered in various shades of brown to indicate grain and texture. The background of the drawing is an unadorned, off-white or beige color. There is a small signature in the bottom right corner with the text “S. Ezgansion.” The armoire is centered in the composition with no other objects or embellishments present.
title: Armoire
